measurement_limits: Note occupancy gaps are not measured waveform silence: consonants, breath and FX may extend beyond rectangles.
Per-track gaps include other speakers' turns; all-track union reports global note occupancy gaps separately.
Duplicate tempo positions use the last serialized event at that position; all supplied bend values are zero.
Visible clipped occurrences are counted; stored copied full contents are excluded from phrase counts.
Hyphen continuation chains are note-encoding units, not proven linguistic syllables or words.
Empty current syllable versus nonempty frozen default is not an explicit pronunciation override.
Raw pitchDelta data is source-relative; no exact synthesized F0 or actual voicing is available offline.
Leading consonants precede note start; their stored lengths are not emitted lengths and are not contained in the note duration.
Raw co-edit candidates omit explicit VUV overrides and sentinel-like abs(delta)>18 solely for inspectability.
No correlation below establishes an acoustic relationship, a universal speech rule, or a repair threshold.
